item.title: PSNI: Romance fraud costs Northern Ireland victims £866,700 in 10 months
item.description: More than £866,000 has been lost to romance fraud in Northern Ireland in the past 10 months, according to figures released by the Police Service of Northern Ireland (PSNI), as officers issue a warning ahead of Valentine’s Day.
